Who We Are 

 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. 

 What We Offer 

 Location:
Rehovot,ISR 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
 
 
 .
 Job Description: Algorithm Developer 
 We are looking for a highly talented Algorithm Developer to join our unique product team and help build the next-generation applications and products.
 
 What’s in it for you? 
 You’ll be part of a team developing advanced algorithms for image processing in the semiconductor industry. This role combines cutting-edge algorithm development with high-performance infrastructure design, enabling efficient data streaming and real-time processing for complex workflows.
 
 Our Group 
 We are part of the R&D department of a major brand new and exciting Product, responsible for developing the next generation software and algorithm solutions that will power Applied Materials’ cutting-edge metrology and inspection system.
 
 What you'll be doing 
 Design and implement Registration and Scoring algorithms for the Detection domain, including Image to CAD alignment, non‑rigid registration, Defect detection and localization algorithms
 Build Zero to Low Shot training capabilities and contribute to algorithm flows Usability and robustness
 Work closely with image processing software engineers to optimize your algorithm and support the fastest inspection tool in the world.
 Collaborate with architecture and product teams to ensure seamless integration of algorithms, refining requirements and designing scalable solutions that solves customers problems.
 
 What you should have 
 5+ years of experience in research and development of deep learning and image processing algorithms.
 M.Sc. or Ph.D. in a relevant engineering field
 Proven track record of designing and implementing robust, production-ready solutions.
 Strong attitude to infrastructure development and a collaborative, team-work mindset.
 
 Who we are 
 Applied Materials Israel is home to the Process Diagnostics and Control business unit (PDC). Based in Rehovot, we develop, manufacture, and market cutting-edge machine learning and computer vision-based metrology and inspection products that are essential elements in wafer fabrication. By playing a significant role in enabling the production of the next generation of microchips, our expertise enables our customers to transform possibilities into reality.
